name: Venice
about: Spring and fall are ideal, summer is hot, crowded and can smell in the canals, acqua alta flooding is more common Oct–Jan.
overview: A car-free city built on water, where getting lost in the back-canal alleys is as much the point as any single sight.
costOverview: Standing at the bar for coffee or cicchetti is cheap — sit at a table, or step onto a gondola, and prices multiply.

specialSeasons.text: Carnival season brings elaborate masks and costumed crowds to the city.
Acqua alta flooding in St. Mark's Square is more common this time of year.
